caption: The drawing depicts an ornate, metallic object resembling a large decorative key or ceremonial scepter, with an elaborate, symmetrical design. The object is oriented vertically on a plain, light-colored background. At the top, there is a squared or slightly rounded end, attached to a short metal chain that leads to a pointed pin. The main shaft of the object is decorated with raised, oval-shaped medallions bordered by metallic filigree, set against a surface with intricate details and embellishments. About one-third from the bottom, the structure flares into a quatrefoil shape, with four prominent rounded lobes, each containing an oval medallion surrounded by ornate metalwork, and additional filigree patterns fill the spaces between. The primary color of the object is metallic silver or grey, with subtle shading in blue and darker grey to suggest texture and depth. The entire composition is centered, with little to no additional elements elsewhere on the page.
title: Bracelet
